prompt:
Key art for a mobile game: one train carriage shown as a cutaway cross-section. Inside is a cosy improvised home for survivors: bunk beds, a small iron stove with a glowing fire, hanging lamps, pipes along the ceiling, crates and patched blankets. Four survivors in warm winter clothes (fur hats, scarves, goggles) do everyday tasks: one cooks at the stove, one repairs a pipe, one reads in a bunk, a child warms their hands. Through the windows in the back wall: a snowy landscape at night.

Art style: premium 2D mobile game art, semi-flat storybook illustration. Clean, confident, simple shapes with minimal clutter; subtle paper-grain texture; thin dark-brown outlines of even weight; soft cel shading with at most two shade steps; gentle gradients only in skies and light glows.

Colour palette: cold desaturated blues, slate greys and blue-white snow for the world and the metal (#1B2433, #3C4A5C, #7FA3B8, #E8EEF2); rust and old-wood browns (#7A4A32, #5C4636); warm amber and fire orange (#F2A65A, #E8692C, #FFD89A) used ONLY for lamps, lit windows, fire and other light sources.

Mood: a bleak, freezing post-apocalyptic world, yet the train carries warmth, hope and human life.

View: architectural cutaway cross-section of the carriage seen exactly from the side, like a dollhouse with the near wall removed; we look straight at the back wall; no perspective.

No text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, watermarks, UI or frames anywhere in the image.
